facts.fact: 约会夜：Bryony 穿上母亲三个圣诞节前送、从未上过身的小黑裙，赴与 David 的高档餐厅晚餐之约。
facts.anchor: In the end she’d settled for the little black dress that her mother had given her three Christmases ago and which she’d never worn.

facts.fact: 下马威：Jack 来 babysit，一见她的裙子眼神骤冷——Bryony 的自信当场泄掉。
facts.anchor: ‘I haven’t eaten.’ His eyes slid down her body and he frowned, his expression suddenly hostile.

facts.fact: 挑衅：他嫌这身打扮「发错信号」，她回敬——我要发的就是这个信号。
facts.anchor: ‘That’s because I don’t think you should be going out with a man dressed like that,’ he said tightly. ‘It sends out all the wrong messages.’

facts.fact: 婚礼游戏：Lizzie 逼 Jack 玩「Weddings」——唯一让他起疹子的游戏，全程被录像。
facts.anchor: Jack was brilliant at playing with her daughter but ‘Weddings’ was the one game guaranteed to bring him out in a rash.

facts.fact: 心口发酸：看她俩玩游戏，Bryony 忍不住想——Jack 会是个多好的父亲，只是他自己看不见。
facts.anchor: Jack was so brilliant with Lizzie. And although he couldn’t see it himself, he’d make a wonderful father.

facts.fact: 越权：出门前 Jack 给 David 立规矩——她十一点前必须到家，David 竟没敢顶。
facts.anchor: ‘She needs to be home at eleven.’

facts.fact: Babysit 心不在焉：Jack 念故事书满脑子是那袭黑裙——从校队比赛后他就没见过她的腿。
facts.anchor: but he now realised that his best friend had sensational legs.

facts.fact: 搅局：Jack 借「紧急事件」让 Lizzie 打晚安电话，约会三度被打断，David 干脆送她回家。
facts.anchor: ‘A big emergency. Her baby girl wants to say goodnight.’

facts.fact: 当众点破：为 Lizzie 的篝火派对他强行随行，Bryony 一句「你不是她爸爸」当着同事脱口而出。
章尾暗流：嘴上认输，她却暗自期待即将和 Jack 共度的篝火之夜。
facts.anchor: And secretly part of her was excited at spending an evening with Jack. Even if it was in the company of half a dozen parents and their offspring.
